name: Call of Fire
label: Quest
description: Call of Fire: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.
Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.
Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. Its mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
